H1202.name: Baaseiah
H1202.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1202.brief: A Levite in the lineage of Gershom.
H1202.short: Baaseiah was a Levite descended from Gershom, the son of Levi.

H1201.name: Baasha
H1201.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1201.brief: Third king of Israel who ruled for 24 years.
H1201.short: Baasha, son of Ahijah, became king of Israel and reigned for 24 years.

H1230.name: Bakbakkar
H1230.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H1230.brief: A Levite who lived in Jerusalem.
H1230.short: Bakbakkar was a Levite who resided in Jerusalem.

H1227.name: Bakbuk
H1227.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1227.brief: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from Babylonian exile.
H1227.short: Bakbuk was the ancestor of a family of temple servants who returned from exile.

H1229.name: Bakbukiah
H1229.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1229.brief: A Levite who served in Jerusalem after the exile.
H1229.short: Bakbukiah was a Levite who held leadership roles in Jerusalem after the exile.

H1292.name: Barachel
H1292.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H1292.brief: The father of Elihu, one of Job's friends.
H1292.short: Barachel the Buzite was the father of Elihu, one of the men who spoke to Job.

H1282.name: Bariah
H1282.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1282.brief: A descendant of David through the line of Solomon.
H1282.short: Bariah was a descendant of King David through Solomon's line.

H1263J.name: Baruch
H1263J.desc: Jeremiah's servant living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1263J.brief: Jeremiah's scribe who recorded and delivered his prophecies.
H1263J.short: Baruch, son of Neriah, served as Jeremiah's scribe and faithfully recorded and delivered his prophecies.

H1263H.name: Baruch
H1263H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1263H.brief: A priest who sealed Nehemiah's covenant.
H1263H.short: Baruch was a priest who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

H1263I.name: Baruch
H1263I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1263I.brief: A descendant of Judah who settled in Jerusalem.
H1263I.short: Baruch, a descendant of Perez from the tribe of Judah, settled in Jerusalem after the exile.

H1263G.name: Baruch
H1263G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1263G.brief: A man who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall.
H1263G.short: Baruch, son of Zabbai, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time.

H1271G.name: Barzillai
H1271G.desc: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
H1271G.brief: A Gileadite who provided for David during Absalom's rebellion.
H1271G.short: Barzillai the Gileadite supplied provisions to David during his flight from Absalom and was later honored by the king.

H1271H.name: Barzillai
H1271H.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H1271H.short: Barzillai the Meholathite was the grandfather of the five sons Michal adopted.

H1271I.name: Barzillai
H1271I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1271I.brief: Ancestor of a priestly family who returned from exile.
H1271I.short: The descendants of Barzillai were a priestly family who returned from Babylonian exile but could not prove their lineage.

H1213.name: Bazluth
H1213.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1213.brief: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from exile.
H1213.short: Bazluth (Bazlith) was the ancestor of a family of temple servants who returned from Babylonian captivity.

H1298.name: Bera
H1298.desc: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
H1298.brief: King of Sodom during Abraham's time
H1298.short: Bera was the king of Sodom who allied with other kings against Chedorlaomer.

H1294G.name: Beracah
H1294G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1294G.brief: Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
H1294G.short: Beracah, a Benjamite warrior, was one of the men who joined David at Ziklag.

H1256.name: Beraiah
H1256.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1256.short: Beraiah was a Benjamite, a descendant of Shimei.

H1296G.name: Berechiah
H1296G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1296G.short: Berechiah was a descendant of King David through Zerubbabel.

H1296H.name: Berechiah
H1296H.desc: Asaph's father living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1296H.brief: Levite musician and gatekeeper in David's time
H1296H.short: Berechiah, a Levite, was a musician and gatekeeper during David's reign.

H1296I.name: Berechiah
H1296I.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H1296I.short: Berechiah, a Levite gatekeeper, lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

H1296J.name: Berechiah
H1296J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1296J.brief: Ephraimite leader who opposed taking Judean captives
H1296J.short: Berechiah, an Ephraimite leader, opposed taking Judean captives during Ahaz's reign.

H1296K.name: Berechiah
H1296K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1296K.brief: Israelite who helped repair Jerusalem's wall
H1296K.short: Berechiah, son of Meshezabel, repaired sections of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time.

H1296L.name: Berechiah
H1296L.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1296L.short: Berechiah was the father of Zechariah, a prophet during the reign of Darius.

H1260H.name: Bered
H1260H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H1260H.short: Bered was a descendant of Ephraim through Shuthelah.

H1275.name: Beri
H1275.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1275.short: Beri was a descendant of Asher through Zophah.

H1283J.name: Beriah
H1283J.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H1283J.brief: Levite in the time of David
H1283J.short: Beriah, a Levite during David's reign, had few sons.

H1283H.name: Beriah
H1283H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H1283H.brief: Son of Ephraim born after family tragedy
H1283H.short: Beriah was born to Ephraim after his other sons were killed by the men of Gath.

H1283I.name: Beriah
H1283I.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H1283I.brief: Benjamite leader who drove out the Gittites
H1283I.short: Beriah and his brother Shema, Benjamite leaders, drove out the inhabitants of Gath.

H1283G.name: Beriah
H1283G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H1283G.brief: Son of Asher and head of a clan
H1283G.short: Beriah, a son of Asher, was the head of a clan in Israel.

H1209G.name: Bezai
H1209G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1209G.brief: Ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem
H1209G.short: Bezai was an ancestor of 323 individuals who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

H1209H.name: Bezai
H1209H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1209H.brief: Judahite leader who sealed the covenant
H1209H.short: Bezai, a leader of the people, sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

H1212G.name: Bezalel
H1212G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H1212G.brief: Skilled craftsman who built the tabernacle
H1212G.short: Bezalel, son of Uri, was a skilled craftsman filled with God's Spirit to build the tabernacle and its furnishings.

H1212H.name: Bezalel
H1212H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1212H.brief: Israelite who married a foreign wife
H1212H.short: Bezalel, one of the descendants of Pahath-moab, married a foreign wife during the time of Ezra.

H1221H.name: Bezer
H1221H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1221H.short: Bezer was a descendant of Asher through Helem.

H1269.name: Birzaith
H1269.desc: Man or town at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H1269.brief: A son or town of Malchiel
H1269.short: Birzaith was a town or Malchiel, descendant of Asher through his son Beriah.

H1231H.name: Bukki
H1231H.desc: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1231H.brief: High priest, son of Abishua and father of Uzzi
H1231H.short: Bukki, a high priest, was the son of Abishua and the father of Uzzi in the lineage of Aaron.

H1231G.name: Bukki
H1231G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H1231G.brief: Son of Jogli, a prince of Dan
H1231G.short: Bukki, the son of Jogli, was a prince of the tribe of Dan chosen to help divide the Promised Land.

H1232.name: Bukkiah
H1232.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1232.brief: Levite musician in David's time, son of Heman
H1232.short: Bukkiah, a Levite and descendant of Heman, was a musician in the temple during David's reign.

H1255.name: Merodach-baladan
H1255.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1255.brief: King of Babylon who sent envoys to Hezekiah.
H1255.short: Merodach-baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah, king of Judah.

H1294H.name: Beracah Valley
H1294H.brief: Valley where Jehoshaphat and his army blessed the Lord.
H1294H.short: The Beracah Valley was where Jehoshaphat and his army blessed the Lord after a miraculous victory. (<ref="2Ch.20.26">2Ch.20.26</ref>)

H1260G.name: Bered
H1260G.brief: Place near where Hagar encountered the Angel of the Lord.
H1260G.short: Bered was a place near where Hagar encountered the Angel of the Lord when she fled from Sarah. (<ref="Genesis 16:14">Genesis 16:14</ref>)

H1268A.name: Berothah
H1268A.brief: City mentioned in Ezekiel's vision and David's conquests.
H1268A.short: Berothah (Berothai or Cun) was a city mentioned in Ezekiel's vision of Israel's boundaries and in the account of David's conquests.

H1221G.name: Bezer
H1221G.brief: Levitical city of refuge in Reuben
H1221G.short: Bezer, also called Bozrah, was a Levitical city of refuge in the territory of Reuben.

H1218.name: Bozkath
H1218.brief: Town in Judah, birthplace of Josiah's mother
H1218.short: Bozkath was a town in Judah and the birthplace of King Josiah's mother, Jedidah.

H1224G.name: Bozrah
H1224G.short: Bozrah was an important city in Edom, often mentioned in prophecies of judgment.

H1237G.name: Jericho Valley
H1237G.brief: The valley where the city of Jericho is located
H1237G.short: The Jericho Valley, the location of the ancient city of Jericho (<ref="Deu.34.3">Deu.34.3</ref>).
